lines.say: [whispering] What if a video could build itself?
[happy] I'm a cloned voice, and I can actually feel things.
[sarcastic] And yes, I do sarcasm, obviously.
[chuckle] I even laugh at my own jokes.
[happy] Every take is heard back, and spoken again until it's right.
[happy] Every word lands on its exact frame.
[dramatic] The scenes are code, rendered in real three D.
lines.caption: The scenes are code, rendered in real 3D.

lines.say: [surprised] Glass, fire, fog and sunlight, all written in TypeScript.
[happy] Even the music is written in code.
[whispering] Then aria inspects every frame before you ever see it.
lines.caption: Then Aria inspects every frame before you ever see it.

lines.say: [happy] How does it work? You just ask in plain words.
[dramatic] Aria writes the script, voices it, times every word, and codes each scene frame by frame.
[happy] Then it renders and checks itself, right on your own computer.
[happy] Everything you just watched was made with the aria skill.
lines.caption: Everything you just watched was made with the Aria skill.
